description: A failing GitHub Actions check on its second run attempt (runAttempt: 2) with an otherwise clean branch (not BEHIND or CONFLICTS) and no other actionable work. Shepherd's single rerun allowance was already consumed by attempt 1, and a clean branch offers no branch-refresh path either, so Shepherd prints one bounded investigation TRIAGE (the 'Check follow-up' playbook) and escalates check-follow-up-unavailable only if the same checks are unchanged on the next tick.
